verdict.rationale: Custom objects are a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions defining custom objects, custom fields, or custom relationships. The closest items are adjacent features (batch-adding leads with contacts and companies, linking leads, and UI widgets via the Web SDK), and none of them models new object types.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
